column1: # One row per file, tab-separated: package, version, tarball sha-256, member, member sha-256, goal, form, license (SPDX), license member, license sha-256.
# Every file is fetched from the npm registry's tarball of that exact version, never committed, and checked by hash (tools/corpus/fetch.sh).
# A row is added only for a file under a plainly redistributable license (MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3-Clause); owner question Q-59 asks the owner to confirm that rule.
